issues: Preview-mode React hydration console warning: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` — caused by the emergent visual-editor injecting a `data-ve-dynamic` `<span style={display:contents}>` inside every `<option>`. Not present in production build and does not affect functionality; flagged as noise only.

critical_code_review_comments: daily_closing_routes.submit_report — 404 check on agents collection happens AFTER service-identity mismatch check and BEFORE the closed-day check. Order is fine, but consider hoisting the closed-day guard above the DB agent lookup for a marginal DB round-trip saving on a frozen day.

daily_closing_routes.close_day — audit_logs.count for denied uses `timestamp` string comparison against ISO strings (`{$gte: since, $lte: until}`); works because ISO 8601 sorts lexicographically, but note that timestamps stored by log_authz include a `+00:00` suffix (isoformat with tz) while `since`/`until` are plain 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' without offset. In practice the string comparison still succeeds because '2026-07-10T…+00:00' > '2026-07-10T00:00:00', so denied counts are correct — but it's fragile if any log ever lacks the offset. Consider normalising or using proper datetime storage.

daily_closing_routes.morning_briefing — assumes `last['risks']['security']` and `last['general_state']` keys are always present; safe now but no defensive .get(). Fine as long as the schema doesn't drift.

daily_closing_routes.close_day — memory_snapshots version counter uses count_documents+1 per tier per agent (non-atomic). Fine at V1 scale (11 agents × 3 tiers × 1 close/day) but not race-safe under concurrent closures; the day-lock (409) prevents concurrent close, so acceptable.

DailyClosing.jsx submitReport — form.confidence is a string coming from the input; converted with Number(). If user clears the field, Number('') === 0, which is a valid 0-100 value and would submit as 0. Consider defaulting to 80 (EMPTY) or validating.
DailyClosing.jsx — briefing.first_day branch reads `briefing.recommendations[0]` without guarding empty array. Backend always seeds one string in that path, but frontend should still guard.

core_routes.write_memory — scope validation is now correctly extended to operational/strategic. MemoryWrite pydantic model still declares scope as free `str`; consider a Literal type for automatic 422 rather than manual 400.
Regression: nav-dashboard link occasionally fails to intercept (5s timeout) when clicked repeatedly during test — probably harmless single flake, not seen on repeat; leaving as note.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_daily_closing.py is the regression suite for Daily Closing Service. It MUST be run with `-n 0` (or in a single worker) — the day-closure is a one-shot mutation and parallel workers would race across Phase A/B. To re-run: 1) reset daily_* collections via a small motor script, 2) `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_daily_closing.py -n 0 -v`. backend_test.py (iteration 1) still runs safely in parallel loadscope. The visual-editor `<span>` in `<option>` hydration warning is preview-only noise.
rca of the issue: No open issues. The initial pytest run with default `-n 2 --dist loadscope` sent Phase-C to worker gw1 while Phase-A/B was still running on gw0 — closure happened out of order relative to reads. Fixed by running with `-n 0` (serial). All 27 tests then pass consistently.
